title: outbox finish_message_delivery bypasses delivery regression guard
description: outbox.rs finish_message_delivery (lines 280-294) uses unconditional UPDATE messages SET delivery_state = ?1 without the 'AND delivery_state \!= delivered' guard that MessageStore::update_delivery_state uses. For the complete_delivery path this can overwrite a previously-set delivered_at with a newer timestamp if a receipt races the outbox worker. For the mark_failed path (finish_message_delivery called with final_state='failed') it can regress a Delivered message to Failed, bypassing the terminal-state barrier that exists in update_delivery_state. The guard is deliberately present in message.rs (line 452) but absent in outbox.rs. Adding AND delivery_state NOT IN ('delivered', 'failed') to the outbox UPDATE closes the gap and makes both paths consistent.
